title: StochLOB: Heavy-Tailed Score Matching for Robust Limit Order Book Trend Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.21081v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Score-based diffusion methods usually perturb data with Brownian Gaussian noise, corresponding to a light-tailed forward stochastic differential equation (SDE). For market time series this SDE can be a poor abstraction: limit order book (LOB) order flow is heavy-tailed, bursty, and occasionally jump-like. We study STOCHLOB, a training-only score-matching framework that changes the forward diffusion corruption law while leaving the deployed predictor deterministic. Instead of Brownian-only Gaussian corruption, the noising process uses two non-Gaussian SDE-inspired alternatives: jump-L\'evy noise through a compound-Poisson variance mixture, and clipped $\alpha$-stable noise through a positive-stable Gaussian scale mixture. These corruptions inject finite jumps and heavy-tailed residuals into training without requiring reverse-time diffusion sampling at inference. translated_title: StochLOB：用于稳健限价订单簿趋势预测的重尾分数匹配
translated_abstract: 基于分数的扩散方法通常使用布朗高斯噪声对数据进行扰动，这对应于轻尾的前向随机微分方程（SDE）。对于市场时间序列而言，这种SDE可能是一种糟糕的抽象：限价订单簿（LOB）的订单流具有重尾性、突发性，且偶尔呈现跳跃状。我们研究了STOCHLOB，这是一个仅用于训练阶段的分数匹配框架，它改变了前向扩散的损坏规律，同时保持部署的预测器为确定性模型。该加噪过程不再仅使用布朗高斯损坏，而是采用两种受非高斯SDE启发的替代方案：通过复合泊松方差混合实现的跳跃Lévy噪声，以及通过正稳定高斯尺度混合实现的截断α稳定噪声。这些损坏机制在训练中注入了有限跳跃和重尾残差，而无需在推理阶段进行反向时间扩散采样。所得的分数目标具有一个有用的解释：其径向因子h（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出StochLOB训练框架，用跳跃Lévy噪声和截断α稳定噪声等重尾非高斯扩散过程替代传统的布朗高斯噪声来加噪训练数据，以更好地捕捉限价订单簿订单流的重尾与跳跃特性，从而提升LOB趋势预测的稳健性，同时推理阶段保持确定性预测器。
en_tdlr: StochLOB is a training-only score-matching framework that replaces Brownian Gaussian noise with heavy-tailed, jump-aware non-Gaussian corruption (jump-Lévy and clipped α-stable noise) to better model the bursty order flow of limit order books, yielding more robust LOB trend prediction while keeping inference deterministic.
